add_library(core_sqlite STATIC sqlite3.c)
target_include_directories(core_sqlite PUBLIC .)
target_compile_definitions(core_sqlite PUBLIC SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5=1 SQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION=1 SQLITE_DQS=0 SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1 SQLITE_DEFAULT_MEMSTATUS=0)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(core_sqlite PRIVATE /W0)
else()
  target_compile_options(core_sqlite PRIVATE -w)
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  target_link_libraries(core_sqlite PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} m)
endif()
